description.value: Little Hell's Gate Regional Park is a TNRD-managed regional park in the North Thompson corridor, named for its dramatic canyon scenery reminiscent of the famous Hell's Gate on the Fraser River. Sitting at roughly 51.9°N near the confluence of rugged interior BC geography, it is tagged as a viewpoint in OpenStreetMap, suggesting a scenic overlook experience. Touring cyclists riding through the Cariboo, Chilcotin and Central Interior region may find it a worthwhile detour for the views.

With no substantive park-specific content available, all amenity fields must remain null — no positive or negative evidence exists for bike parking, washrooms, or any optional amenity.
